## How to Use These Reports

### For Developers
Start with the **Summary** for overall health, then drill into individual reports for specific areas.

### For CI/CD
All commands passed - system is ready. Review the **Summary** for any warnings.

### For Debugging
If issues arise, check individual reports for detailed test results and error messages.

### For Planning
Review **Recommendations** sections in each report for improvement opportunities.

## Report Structure

Each individual report contains:
- **Summary**: Quick status overview
- **Key Findings**: Main results
- **Issues Detected**: Problems found (if any)
- **Technical Details**: Deep dive information
- **Recommendations**: Suggested actions
- **Conclusion**: Final assessment

## Update Schedule

These reports are point-in-time snapshots from 2025-10-09. Rerun commands and regenerate reports when:
- Makefile changes
- Test suite changes
- After bug fixes
- Before major releases

## Commands to Regenerate

```bash

make validate-safety 2>&1 | tee logs/validate-safety-run.log
make validate-targets 2>&1 | tee logs/validate-targets-run.log
make test-system 2>&1 | tee logs/test-system-run.log
make dev-test 2>&1 | tee logs/dev-test-run.log

# Then regenerate reports based on new logs
```
